text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
KABLAMMM!!!
I just realized somethin' incredible!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I was just watching videos of hammer throw! And then, and then, I realized something...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: If we scream super loud, wouldn't that make us jump crazy far!?

text_block_list.name: Helios & Palmer
text_block_list.text: BAKU-FLEE-INGGGGGG!!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa?! The distance seriously got longer!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
True, when people get serious in a race, they shout to summon their strength...
Maybe we should give it a shot too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hmm, something I'm dying to scream right now, huh...

text_block_list.name: Jordan & City
text_block_list.text:
This test is bad news!!
Fly, fly away!! ...Wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "No, wait, a test? Seriously...?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I just thought it'd be easier to unleash my true feelings, y'know?
Like, that totally came straight from my gut just now, right?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Are you a genius or what?!
Let's all do it! Spill our true feelings!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, alright! If we're all gonna
let loose together... it's gotta be *that* phrase, right?

text_block_list.name: Gals
text_block_list.text: Ready, and!

text_block_list.name: Gals
text_block_list.text:
Besties, let's gooo! Besties are the strongest!
Besties, looove ya! Besties are the best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait, so we're barely not in sync?!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's hilarious!
I mean, we're totally of one mind, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Is this youth or what? So touching!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. Actually, everyone set new personal bests.
If we can keep this up on race day—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, hold on.
Does this mean I have to scream this on the day of the race too?"

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Riiight~☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Eh... Yes.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's win this, City☆
With the power of besties for life♡

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Don't be shy.
After all...

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Besties are the absolute best, after all~♪

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah, jeez, I said I get it!
